name: Mist

overview.desc: Mist not only has a unique effect (Fear) reduces Effect Resistance of enemies to 0% and allows her to inflict Unremovable Death on enemies, she also has the ability to reduce Buff Duration before applying it, negating any enemy's CC Immunity, allowing her debuffs to land without too much difficulty.

lines: - Deals damage equal to 100% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).

tips.body: Unable to act for the duration of the effect, and Effect Resistance is set to 0%.

Adds Effect: 40% chance to inflict Fear. [Duration: 1 Turn(s)]

lines: - Deals damage equal to 57% of Magic Attack 2 time(s).
- 35% chance to inflict Death. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]. (Inflicts Unremovable Death when target is inflicted with Fear)

tips.name: Death
tips.body:
Target takes damage equal to 20% of the target's current HP every turn, instantly dying on the last turn.
Target dies instantly upon reaching 2 stacks of Death.

dedicated.name: Mist's Shackles

why_by_stat.AllATK%: Mist requires high Attack to gain advantage over her enemies.
why_by_stat.EffectRes: Helps Mist resist enemy effects and perform their role more reliably. Going above 100% Effect Resistance can still be useful.

dedicated.story:
"Indeed... a monster is a monster."

A girl —caged and imprisoned in magical shackles— attempted to escape by swinging a massive iron mace, but failed. After subduing the girl, who had gone berserk after losing her memories, Freyja labeled her a monster and orders that the experiments continue. Once again, the girl is confined and restrained, bound by cold, unyielding shackles.

lore: Originally known as Sanzang, she agreed to become Freyja's test subject on the condition that Sun Wukong's life would be spared. After undergoing Freyja's various experiments, she loses her sense of self and memories, becoming an emotionless biological weapon. When Sun Wukong, unaware that she had become a test subject, appears before her, it stirs a lingering feeling of longing and nostalgia within her, and she is able to recognize him despite having lost her memories.
